verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents an official MCP server that lets LLMs work directly with Appwrite's API and docs. The docs name Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Claude Desktop as clients that can operate on a project and pull current SDK, API and CLI context, and a probe confirms the dedicated MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that connecting an agent works in practice, and detail on setup/authentication and the specific tools the server exposes.
